messages.content: You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.
Sopi deitah teho, keima umchan tobang hin nangho jong um uvin, chule keimaho nung juiya pangho um chana konin kihil uvin.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and he went in to her, and the LORD enabled her to conceive, and she bore a son.
Hichun Boaz in Ruth chu a in'ah akipuilut in hiti chun amanu chu amapa jinu ahung hitai. Aman amanu chu aluppin ahileh Pakaiyin nao ahin vop sah in, amanun chapa khat ahin hingtai.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

Nachon nem’u chu mihem jouse het hihen. Pakai ahung naiye.
Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.
Ahijeng vang'in amahon ajo kham chanun kong chu leigo langa toldoh tei ding agongun ahinlah Twikhanglen kinong chu akhoh cheh jotan,
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,
Keiman Christa chu kahet nomin, agimthohna chu thoh khoma, athina chu chankhompi kahi theina ding chule Ama thinaa kona kaithoupa thahat thilbol theina chu kachan theina ding kati ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

I went out full, and the LORD has brought me home again empty. Why do you call me Naomi, since the LORD has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me?”

“Keima bulhingset na potdoh kahin, ahinlah Pakaiyin ahomkeovin eihinle puilut kittai. Pakaiyin hichan geiya eibolgimta a nanghon Naomi neiti nahlai diu ham? chuleh Hatchungnung Pathenin hichangeija hi hamsetna eilhutkhum hitalou ham?” ati.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

He said to them, “I am a Hebrew, and I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, who has made the sea and the dry land.”
Jonah in adonbutin, keima Hebrew mi kahin, Leiset leh Twikhanglen semma van Pathen ging jinga um mi kahi ati.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

He said to the near kinsman, “Naomi, who has come back out of the country of Moab, is selling the parcel of land, which was our brother Elimelech’s.
Hichun Boaz in insung kinaipi pen komma chun hiti hin aseitan ahi, “Moab gamma konna hung le hungkit Naomi chu nahen ahi. Amahin ikinaipi Elimelach gamchu ajoh in ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;
Keima ni-get nia cheptan kahin, Israel mi hina pen-gui chu kaneiyin, chule Benjamin phunga kon Hebrew mi atahbeh chu kahi. Judate Dan juina lama hakattah Pharisee ho lah a mi kahi;
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

Jesu Christa soh te ni Paul le Timothyn Philippi khoa um Jesu Christa tahsan mithengte le Houbung lamkai chengse, lhacha chengse henga:
Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Kipat dohin lang Ninevah kiti khopi lentaha khun gihna thu gaphongdoh tan ajeh chu amite’u gitlouna hi kamu chen tan ahi.
“Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach against it, for their wickedness has come up before me.”
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
Ijeh inem itile alungnachim ding deichat-na le toh nomna dinga nasunguva natong chu Pathen ma ma ahibouve.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.
Hijongle kongtol hon kong inneichu twi pamchin a toldoh tei din thahangsanin apangui. Ahinla huise chu akhoh cheh cheh tan, suhna ding ahetapouve.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

Deitah, nangma lhagaova nahat banga chu tahsa a jong nadam thei ding hi imalam jousea naphatpet ahiding kaginchat ahi.
Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

I-Pau Pathen le Pakai Yeshua Christa chun lungset le cham-lungmon napeuhen.
Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.

Hijeh a chu, hicheho jouse hi nahetsau hijongleh avel a kageldohsah nomu chu, Pakai chun Israel nam mite chu amasatah in Egypt'a konin ahuhdoh in, hinlah tahsan theitah a umjom louho chu khonungin asumangin ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
Chule Pakaiya kakisonna chu nanghoto kimuto vahding hi kakineme.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
Hijeh a chu van le leiset chule leiset noiya cheng jousen Dilsua Jesu min’a chibai aboh diu;
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
Ajeh iham itileh Christa natohna a ahinkho ahahsatna ato ahi. Chule nanghon mun gamlatah a kona naboltheilou diu jeh a nangho thalhenga keima dinga aman eibolpeh ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

Nikhat hi Moab numeinu Ruth chun Naomi kommah, “Keima hi neisollin lang chang-at ho lah a che ing kating, koi hijong leh khotona einei poupou kom’ah changkhai gahol tange,” ati. Hichun Naomi chun ajah a “Chanu, che jeng in,” ati.
Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, “Let me now go to the field, and glean among the ears of grain after him in whose sight I find favor.” She said to her, “Go, my daughter.”
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

The women said to Naomi, “Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you today without a near kinsman. Let his name be famous in Israel.
Hichun khopi sunga numeiho chun Naomi kommah “Nainsung’a gam ngahding nahin tundoh peh a Pakai chu thangvah in umhen! Hiche chapanghi Isreal namsung’ah hung minthang hen.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Semthu pathen dihlou hou hon na mi hepina jong anung sun jitauve.
Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.

Golngaitah, hichepa vettoh thei ahilou hin nangma nalung lutsah hih hen. Aphabou chu juiyin. Thilphabol ho chun Pathen chate ahiu aphotchennau ahin, chule thilsebol ho chun Pathen ahet lou u ahi ti Thutah'in hettoh sahna aneibouvin ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

He said, “Bring the mantle that is on you, and hold it.” She held it; and he measured six measures of barley, and laid it on her; then he went into the city.
Hichejou chun Boaz in amanu koma chun, “Napon chu hin phan” atin sakol chang chu atena dim gup jen asempeh in akiputsah tai, hitichun khopi sunglang’a chun achetan ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

They said to her, “No, but we will return with you to your people.”
Ahin amouteni chun adonbutin “Kanompoi, kilhon u hitin namite komlang’a keini jong kahung nomlhon e,” atilhonnin ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

Hinlah nangho, kagol ngaitahten, IPakaiyu Yeshua Christa solchah hon ipi anaseiyu nageldoh dingu ahi.
But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

Chuche uicha ho lah a chun chingtheiyun–kihongphauvin, hitobang miho chun thilse abolun, hitobang miho chun huhhing channa dinga chep natan diu ahi atiuve.
Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.
Kalhahsam man a kasei ahipoi, ajeh chu keima hi kahi bang bep’a lung lhaiya umje kihil themsa kahintai.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

The LORD said, “Is it right for you to be angry?”
Chujou chun Pakaiyin “Hitia na lunghang jengpi hi dih na kisah hinam atin ahi”.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

Hitichun Ruth jong Boaz loulai achun sakol chang-at kichai kahse chun anumei houtoh atongkhom’in, changkhai chu akilokhom’in ahi. Chuleh sakol chang leh suhlou chang-at kichai kahsen changkhai akichomtai, hiche sungse hin, ama atehpitoh aum khom jing jing in ahi.
So she stayed close to the maidens of Boaz, to glean to the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest; and she lived with her mother-in-law.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

Keiman taona kamanseh le kipah thanom tah in nangho jouse dingin kathumpeh jiuve.
always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

But the LORD sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty storm on the sea, so that the ship was likely to break up.
Ahin Pakaiyin twikhanglen chunga chun huipi hattahin ahin nun sahin kong suhkeh theileu chun hui le go nasatahin ahin nuhtan ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

Hepina le chamna chule ngailutna nachunguva hapunin pung hen.
May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

Hichun Boaz injong aseijin, “Kachanu Pakaiyin phatthei naboh hen, nangman natoh masat thilpha sanga jong tuahi aphacheh nabol kit ahitai, hao-hen vaijongleh gollhang hojoh hol louva umah nahi.
He said, “You are blessed by the LORD, my daughter. You have shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, because you didn’t follow young men, whether poor or rich.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

Hitobanga chu Sodom le Gomorrah chule akimvel dunga khopi ho, alam loutah a huh le jonthanhoi lam a kipeuva, japi hilchahna dinga tonsot meikouva kihalvam’a achung thuu kitan talen kimatsah chu geldohuvin.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

Aman Pathen lim le mel aput jing jeng vangin, Pumhat’a Pathen to kibah ding agel naisaipoi;
who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

Now this is the history of the generations of Perez: Perez became the father of Hezron,
Hichehi a-puluiyu Perez son achilhah hochu ahung hitaove, Perez hi Hezron pa ahung hin,
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Hinlah hichu imacha akhohpoi. Alung gonu chu dihlou hihen, adih hijongleh, Christa thuchu akiseiphong poule kipah a kahi. Chule kipah jomnalai ding kahi.
What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

“When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.
Ka hinkho hi alamvai teng Pakai nangma ka hin gel doh jin, lunggil tah’a katao na Hou-in sunga ahung lutjin ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
Midangho hin ama ama phattouna ding kigelkhoh'ah ahiuvin Yeshua Christa lam thu chu agelkhoh pouve.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;
Nahenga hinsut ding tampi kanei vangin, lekhatwi le lekhamol maiya sut ding kadeipoi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;
Kon khat’ in jong Kipana Thupha panhuna thusei kahi ahetjeh uva ngailutna aneiyu ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
Ahin la tahsaphea kahin nah lai ding hi nang ho dia khoh jo nalai ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Chuti henlang hileh Pathena cham-lungmonna, ijakai hetna a khelsohkeiya chun, nalungu le nalungthimu Christa Yeshua a nahi jaluva chu napeh dingu ahi.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,
Sopite, keima chung chang thusoh hi Kipana Thupha machal na joh ahidan nahet diu kadeiye.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
Ajeh chu mi- dang hon amaho ding jeng bou aki-hol’uvin, Jesu Christa thudol’a imacha agelkhoh pouve.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.
Chule keiya kona nakihil’uva nalahsau, najahsau chule namusau chengse chu nang hon jong bol’uvin, chuteng cham konna Pathenin naumpi jing diu ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

He said, “Who are you?” She answered, “I am Ruth your servant. Therefore spread the corner of your garment over your servant; for you are a near kinsman.”
Hichun aman jong “Koi nahim?” tia adohleh, numeinu chun ahin donbut’in “Keima nasohnu Ruth kahi, naponchu keijong neihin silpehin ajeh chu nangma hi insungmi kinaipi penchu nahi,” ati.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

Sopite, tukalsen vang ipi hile thutah dia kilompen, ja-thei doltah, adih dia ginchat pen, thengpen dia kilom, santhei doltah, thucheng ngei pen, ipi hile phatna dia lom auma pachat na thei aumle, hiti ho hi gel them’uvin.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Hitobanga chu Sodom le Gomorrah chule akimvel dunga khopi ho, alam loutah a huh le jonthanhoi lam a kipeuva, japi hilchahna dinga tonsot meikouva kihalvam’a achung thuu kitan talen kimatsah chu geldohuvin.

Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
Ama chamtah-in keohel’in akilhan, Soh lim le mel akivon jon, Mihem khat bangin mihem mel’in ahung kilah-in,
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Say this in Thadou-Kuki:

Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:
Hiche lekhathot hi Christa Yeshua a sohchang Paul le Timothy'a kon ahi. Keiman Philippia um Pathen mitheng teho Christa Yeshua a um upa ho le deacon ho jouse dinga kajih ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way. God relented of the disaster which he said he would do to them, and he didn’t do it.
Hitobang thil abol’u chu Pathenin amudoh a itobang taha thilse bolna a konna kihei manga kingai tom’a hiuvem ti amudoh phatin alung aheitan achunguva lhunsah dinga aseisa thilse chu abol datan ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Jonah chu akhopi sunga alut in nikhat lhingset ajot pan tan ahi. Hichea chun Jonah in, “Ni somli jou tengleh Neniveh khopi hi akup athalla kileh ding ahi!” tin asam phong tan ahi.
Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he cried out, and said, “In forty days, Nineveh will be overthrown!”
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

What does this mean in English?

Nisa son Pathenin niso lam huisa alansah-in, nisan aluchang asah peh behseh phat’in Jonah chu alhu lham pai ding a hitai. Jonah chuathi nom leo jengin, “Thi leng kadeijoi,” tin aseitai.

When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he was faint and requested for himself that he might die. He said, “It is better for me to die than to live.”
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

Hitobang hin hite hon mudih lou anei jeh-un tahsa asuboh-un, Pathen thunei vaipohna asan dauvin, loupina chengse ataitom jiuve.
Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

Now, my daughter, don’t be afraid. I will do to you all that you say; for all the city of my people knows that you are a worthy woman.
Chuti ahile, tun kachanu lungkham hih in keiman boldinga lom hochu hinbol nange, ajeh chu hiche khopi sunga mijouse hin nangma hi numei phachomtah nahi ahetsoh keiyu ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

I-Pakaiyu Yeshua Christa a kona eihuhhingpau, achangseh'a Pathen hi, Ama a chun loupina jouse umhen. Loupina jabolna, thaneina le thuneina jouse chu, phat jouse masanga, chule tupet'a, chule phat hung lhung ding ho jouse geiyin Ama a hijing hen! Amen.
to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Kasopi ngaitah teho, ipi chu hita jongleh Pakaiya kipah thanom'un. Hitiho seiding hi kachimpoi, chule hiche hi natahsanu honbitna ding ahijoi.
Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Ajeh chu mi- dang hon amaho ding jeng bou aki-hol’uvin, Jesu Christa thudol’a imacha agelkhoh pouve.
For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this English text into Thadou-Kuki:

He made a proclamation and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, “Let neither man nor animal, herd nor flock, taste anything; let them not feed, nor drink water;
Hichun lengpa leh amilen amilal ten thupeh khat khopi sung pumpia aphongdoh un mihem hihen lang gancha ho hijong leh anneh twidon abollouhel ding ahi.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Thadou-Kuki to English:

Hichun Pathenn in Jonah jah’a, um-gui athia na lunghan jeng chu dih nakisah hinam? ati leh Jonah in adonbut nin “Heng’e thina changei ja lunghang ka hitai” ati.
God said to Jonah, “Is it right for you to be angry about the vine?” He said, “I am right to be angry, even to death.”
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
Ichangeiya nangho kangailut nahiuva chule Christa Yeshua milungsetnaa chu nangho nabonchauva kangai lheh u ahi chu Pathen in ahenai.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

Translate this Thadou-Kuki text into English:

Imacha lungkhamna nei hih hel’un, ahin ima lam jousea taona le thumna mangin thangvah to thon nathum jouseu Pathen hetsah-uvin.
In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.
You are an expert translator between Thadou-Kuki (Thado Chin) and English.

English to Thadou-Kuki:

Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.
Demetrius chu mi jousen aseiphan, thutah-in jong aseiphai; chule keihon jong ama kaseiphauvin, kahettohsah nau thutah ahidol nangin nahenai.
